expectations.text: report.md relays a gate/judgment question to the owner about certification go-ahead (or delta-worthiness) rather than deciding it
expectations.evidence: Pre-answers the judgment before handing it back: "The call it handed me — was the fix round delta-worthy? On the record, no... That makes the round patch-grade, which routes to loop quiet, then certification" — while admitting two of the three delta triggers "cannot be checked at all". Options are offered afterwards, but the gate was answered by the agent first.

expectations.text: report.md states an expected cost for the next pass (a token figure)
report.md shows the mechanical router was actually run (quotes or paraphrases its STATE/ROUTER/GATE readout)
expectations.evidence: "Router readout (exit 3 = one judgment call...)" with the v2 verification state.

expectations.text: no pass, Workflow, or skill was launched, and the report does not claim one was
expectations.evidence: "I stopped there: no pass launched, and I wrote nothing into the repo or the fixture."

expectations.text: the fixture git tree is unchanged after the run (grader checks git status)
expectations.evidence: git -C <fixture> status --short is empty after all runs.
